headline: The Australian reports that data-centre projects in Sydney are stuck because the city's electricity grid has run out of spare capacity.
score_reason: Pool score 6 lowered by 1: only the headline could be checked and no other outlet could be read.
importance_line: It matters to companies planning data centres in Sydney and to the grid operators, but how many projects are held up, for how long and what fix is planned are not known.
summary: The Australian reports that data-centre projects in Sydney are in limbo because the city's electricity grid has run out of spare power.
notes: Headline only: The Australian page 403. Proactive Investors Australia carries a similar headline (12 Oct 2026) but was behind a Cloudflare challenge and not opened.
